tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[H1 of closed orientable surface] ↗ thm:hurewicz-dimension-1 1. ch2:2A.2\group Singular Homology

For a closed orientable genus-$g$ surface $M$, $H_1(M)\cong \mathbb {Z}^{2g}$, generated by the standard $\alpha _i,\beta _i$ cycles. \end{example}
